description: Set the merge gates. Replace the project's merge gates. Send the whole object (read it with `ops trail-gates get` first).

severity.description: How much a finding matters. The Agent review gate blocks on open findings at or above its configured severity.

attributionWindowHours.description: How long after a trail merged an error or alert ticket may be attributed to it. Trails merged inside the window are offered to the investigating agent as candidates.

autopilot.description: What autopilot may do and spend on one trail. Crossing any one pauses it at a safe point and hands the trail to its owner. The project's defaults live in `trail-gates` `autopilot`.

maxFixRounds.description: Fix rounds per change before autopilot hands the trail over.

maxPullBacks.description: Pull-backs of the rollout before autopilot hands the trail over.

maxRisk.description: The highest Risk agent score (0-100) autopilot may merge at. `null` = no risk limit. With a limit set, a change the Risk agent has not scored (or no Risk agent at all) is a limit hit, never a pass.

maxRuns.description: Agent runs autopilot may start in all (build, fix and investigation runs).

repos.description: Repos (`owner/repo`) autopilot may act in. Empty = any repo the trail may touch.

types.description: Trail types autopilot may act on. Empty = any.

items.description: What a trail is shipping. A `feature` trail is held to the rollback and measured release gates.

required.description: Check names that must pass. Empty means every reported check.

copy.description: Release gate. Passes when every copy i18n key exists in every published locale of its profile. Off by default.

blocking.description: Whether a failing gate blocks the merge (a non-blocking gate only reports).

enabled.description: Whether the gate is evaluated at all.

discovered.description: Passes when no item discovered on the trail is open at or above `priority`. Off by default; turn it on to say "a high bug found while building this blocks shipping it".

priority.description: Triage priority of a queue item. The lowest tier is `nice_to_have` (not `low`) — carried over from the feature-request "importance" scale this priority set replaced.

blocking.description: Whether a failing gate blocks the merge (a non-blocking gate only reports).

enabled.description: Whether the gate is evaluated at all.

fixRounds.description: How many times the server re-fires the coding agent with a fix prompt after a change's evals or findings fail. After the cap the trail reads `reviewing`, needs a person. `0` turns the loop off.

goalWindowDays.description: How many days a delivered trail is watched before its goal metric is judged. A trail is delivered when its plan is approved, every code and tracking item is done and every flag it ships behind is fully rolled out (or, with none, something merged).

guarded.description: Release gate. Passes when every measured resource has at least one guarding alert rule. Off by default.

blocking.description: Whether a failing gate blocks the merge (a non-blocking gate only reports).

enabled.description: Whether the gate is evaluated at all.

authorCanApprove.description: Whether the trail's owner, and whoever started its runs, count as approvers. Off by default, so the author of a change is never its own reviewer.

resetOnPush.description: Whether a new push clears earlier approvals, so the latest code is what gets approved.

intakeMatching.description: Whether new and still-open errors, alerts, bugs and feature requests are compared with the project's open trails. A confident match attaches the item to the trail with the evidence; a weak one lands under the trail's possibly related list for its owner to confirm or reject. Matching never creates a trail.

maxGoalReplans.description: How many times shipeasy re-plans a trail on its own after its goal was missed. Each re-plan proposes new options that differ from what was tried. Past the cap the trail is off track and the owner decides; `0` never re-plans automatically.

maxParallelRuns.description: How many item runs a trail's build keeps working at once. A build launches an item run for each open item of the current milestone, up to this many; the rest wait for a slot.

measured.description: Release gate. For a `feature` trail, passes when a measuring experiment or metric exists. Off by default.

blocking.description: Whether a failing gate blocks the merge (a non-blocking gate only reports).

enabled.description: Whether the gate is evaluated at all.

plan.description: Gate. Passes when every release resource the trail's approved plan lists exists on the trail (a flag, kill switch or experiment the person chose while the plan was made). Reads `pending` while a drafted plan waits for approval, and is left out when the trail has no plan yet. On and blocking by default, whoever approved the plan.

blocking.description: Whether a failing gate blocks the merge. Off, the gate only reports.

enabled.description: Whether the gate is evaluated at all.

additionalProperties.description: A repo's partial override of the project's trail gates.

required.description: Check names that must pass in this repo. Empty means every reported check.

repos.description: Per-repo overrides keyed by `owner/repo`. An override replaces the project's `checks.required` for changes in that repo; every other gate stays project-wide.

requirePlan.description: Whether a person approves a trail's plan before it builds. Every trail is planned first — starting an agent on a trail with no approved plan fires a read-only plan run, and the build follows the approved plan. On, the plan run asks the person how the trail should ship and anything else that is open, and waits for their approval. Off, it asks nothing and takes its own recommendations; a plan the checks raise no warning on approves itself and the build starts, one with a warning waits for a person.

rollback.description: Release gate. For a `feature` trail, passes when a rollback kill switch exists. Off by default.

blocking.description: Whether a failing gate blocks the merge (a non-blocking gate only reports).

enabled.description: Whether the gate is evaluated at all.

rollout.description: How the flag a trail ships behind is ramped after merge — the release controller's plan (see the design doc, the release controller). Part of the plan's release block; the project's defaults live in `trail-gates` `rollout`. The controller runs on the alerts cron, so a hold shorter than the cron interval rounds up to the next tick.

guards.description: What is watched while a step holds. The trail's `guards` alert-rule resources are watched too.

alertRuleIds.description: Alert rules (ids) whose firing during a step is a breach.

attributedErrors.description: Whether a new error attributed to the trail at high confidence is a breach.

experimentGuardrails.description: Whether a breached guardrail of the trail's measuring experiment is a breach.

holdMinutes.description: Minutes a step must stay healthy before the next one.
Minutes the team stage holds healthy before the first public step.

internal.description: The team stage before any public percent — the project's members are allowlisted on the flag (by email) and the step holds like any other. `null` or absent = no team stage.

minExposure.description: Evaluations a step must have served before it counts as healthy, so a quiet hour never passes as a green one. `0` = no floor.

policies.description: The three decisions the plan asks the owner, each with the project default pre-selected.

advance.description: Whether a healthy step advances by itself (`auto`) or waits for the owner to say so (`ask`).

afterFix.description: What happens when the fix merges — `resume` from the last healthy step, `ask` the owner first, or `restart` from the first step.

breachTimeoutMinutes.description: With `ask_then_pull_back`, minutes the owner has before the controller pulls back.

onBreach.description: What to do when a guard trips during a step — `pull_back` (pull the flag back, investigate and suggest a fix, tell the owner; the default), `ask_first` (ask the owner, only notify), or `ask_then_pull_back` (ask, and pull back after `breachTimeoutMinutes` with no answer).

steps.description: Percent steps, each above the one before, the last 100.

shipsDark.description: Release gate. Passes when every flag the trail ships behind exists and is not at 100% in prod, so new code merges off. Off by default.

blocking.description: Whether a failing gate blocks the merge (a non-blocking gate only reports).

enabled.description: Whether the gate is evaluated at all.

enabled.description: Whether the gate is evaluated at all.
